study.question: The supplied successful trajectories give validation AUC: baseline-static 0.6050036145, baseline-pooled 0.6102261137, baseline-din 0.6133619861, r0000-support_rate 0.6129227872, r0000-support_count 0.6133185009, r0000-match_rate 0.6163503542, r0000-match_count 0.6167540723. The target-match contrast is more promising than activity volume in this single seed, but match count versus match rate differs by only 0.0004037182 AUC and count has slightly worse Logloss (0.1965311091 versus 0.1964974232). These do not establish a mechanism. Source inspection shows that the incumbent collapses match ages in its explicit statistics, while its attention already embeds event age. The observed limitation is in the explicit readout, not an assertion that the model lacks time information. Can exposing the association of encoded target matches with event age improve prediction beyond match volume, marginal activity recency and added parameterization?
study.hypothesis: Within each action and supplied category/brand field, timing of matching events carries predictive information beyond their number and the marginal timing of valid-field activity. Add W=sum_j match_j * 2^(-age_j/86400) alongside inherited match counts C. Compare to E=C*U/max(S,1), with S=valid-field action count and U=sum_j valid_j*2^(-age_j/86400). E is the expected W under random reassignment of fixed ages among valid events within that field/action, preserving C and the entire age multiset. The candidate preserves match-age association explicitly. This is a prospective, unverified local hypothesis; monotone decay is a restricted feature basis, not a claim that every action has monotonically decreasing relevance.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/2308.08487v4 (TIN, 2024-07-03), sections 2.1 and 3.1.1-3.1.2, Eq. 2; full mechanism text inspected through web open
nearest_work.difference: TIN combines target-relative temporal encodings with learned target attention and elementwise target-aware representation. This candidate uses deterministic, action-by-field decayed equality counts as an additional scalar readout and an exchangeable-age replacement control. It retains the local parent attention. It is not a TIN reproduction, and a new semantic-temporal modeling claim is not established.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/2311.10764v1 (DGIN, 2023-11-15), sections 3.3.1-3.3.2 and 3.4; full mechanism text inspected through web find/open
nearest_work.difference: DGIN supplies per-type group counts, temporal aggregation and same-item target modeling over lifelong behavior. We inherit the motivation for count statistics, but use only supplied encoded category/brand equality, a fixed capped prefix, and deterministic elapsed-time decay; no item identity, grouping over lifelong data, dwell time or price is invented.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/1706.06978v4 (DIN, 2018-09-13), section 4.3 Eq. 3; primary mechanism text inspected through web find/open
nearest_work.difference: DIN motivates target-aware activation and retains intensity by avoiding softmax normalization. Our inherited local reference uses normalized attention with category/brand/action/age embeddings; existing explicit counts supply a separate intensity readout. We keep that adaptation fixed and test timing of encoded matches rather than claiming exact DIN reproduction.

Parent supplies eight action-by-field target-match counts but no explicit timing-specific count. New modules retain those counts, add eight replacement statistic slots and preserve the full attention path. All four new variants have identical parameter tensors; original parent remains a historical reference with 1024 fewer parameters.

inherited_components: Host-owned data identity bd5ca20f6c2ca3e084ad11e12bf6200adbd293e060e1efb96dcb070f64ff81fa, information boundary, split, scorer, training coverage, history truncation and resource ledger.

r0000-match_count field embeddings, action and log-binned age embeddings, normalized local attention, empty-history masking, MLP hidden widths, eight log1p(count)/log(129) action-by-field statistics, scratch training and optimizer recipe.

Prior contrasts include both unsuccessful activity controls and successful match alternatives. No supplied trajectory failed execution; previous_runtime_error is null. No unavailable failure or human memory is invented.
study.proposed_difference: Implement a sixteen-scalar readout: the original eight C statistics plus eight values from aligned W, factorized E, activity U, or duplicate C. All statistics use log1p(value)/log(129); field order is category, brand and action order pv,cart,fav,buy. Zeros and invalid/missing IDs never match; mask and action IDs 1-4 gate every contribution. Fixed half-life is one calendar day, selected before execution without validation tuning and shared by all modes. All four modules compute identical raw reductions including W, U and E; only the extra input selection changes. This adds exactly 8*128=1024 parameters over the parent, predicting 17132323 total, 17078688 embedding and 53635 dense parameters under the existing meta. Candidate and controls match capacity; measured inference cost may still vary. Every module is standalone with a literal CONFIG. No priority claim; nearest-work coverage is limited to inspected primary sources.
predictions: Primary predeclared exploratory screening contrast: aligned minus factorized full-validation AUC exceeds +0.0002 at host seed 42. A smaller, null or negative difference does not justify the specific match-age association explanation. This threshold is a practical screen, not a significance test.

Aligned should also outperform duplicate and activity controls and the original parent on primary AUC. Report all Logloss changes even if the AUC winner is different; a Logloss loss prevents an unqualified quality claim.

All four modes yield identical inherited counts, raw W/U/E diagnostics, trainable shapes and parameter counts. Only the selected extra statistic differs. First-512 diagnostics should show nonzero W-E for some field/action cells; a negligible residual makes the proposed control weak in that sample.

Use host-provided slice definitions and sample/positive/negative counts unchanged. Category-match-present (2516922 samples,129821 positives,2387101 negatives) and history_gt64 (3026583,151372,2875211) are predeclared relevant slices. Empty history (8272,310,7962) has zero extra evidence in every mode and is a negative-control slice, not an expectation of identical independently trained predictions. Aggregate effects can still occur without matches through joint training. Report all available slices without post-hoc selective claims.

The prior first-512 descriptive diagnostics have only 1.9921875 buy events per impression and zero category-buy encoded matches; this is not a population estimate or evidence that purchases are uninformative. Pool the half-life across actions and treat rare-action and small-slice effects as exploratory.
falsifiers: Aligned fails to improve over factorized at matched shape/data/recipe, or the apparent advantage disappears in paired repetitions: this implementation does not support predictive utility of match-age association.
Duplicate matches aligned: capacity, parameterization or optimization remains sufficient; do not attribute improvement over the original parent to temporal information.
Activity or factorized matches aligned: marginal activity recency or match-count scaling may suffice, so the specific association claim lacks support.
W and E are nearly identical in the supplied prefix, or there are too few informative matches: the experiment is nondiscriminating, not a refutation of timing mechanisms.

Nonfinite values, API errors, budget termination or host execution errors are implementation/resource failures, not scientific negative results. Retain their receipts and cost. No holdout result is available or requested.
alternative_explanations: One-seed validation selection, shared users and multiple correlated contrasts can produce chance improvement. Repeated seeds measure stability, not independent mechanism contrasts; user-cluster uncertainty is unavailable from aggregate feedback.
The parent already encodes age in attention, so a null scalar-readout result can reflect redundancy rather than absence of temporal relevance.

An arbitrary one-day exponential basis may mismatch true action-specific persistence, saturation or repurchase patterns. If diagnostics demonstrate substantial association but the trial is unsuccessful, a separately predeclared time-bin replacement may be a useful future contrast; no tuning or extra trial is silently authorized here.
Encoded equality may conflate collisions, missing values or coarser field meanings; category/brand are not item identity. Sparse buy/fav matches and prefix truncation limit interpretation.

Extra inputs alter initialization shape and optimization relative to the historical parent. New variants share shapes and RNG construction; duplicate is the explicit parameterization control. Equal parameter counts do not ensure equal effective function classes or equal compute.

E preserves C and the mean decay by field/action; it does not expose every aspect of the age distribution to the classifier. The comparison isolates this particular association statistic conditional on the inherited attention, not all possible temporal mechanisms.

Publisher snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, so the frozen benchmark does not establish production point-in-time validity. The coding jail has no torch or raw data, and host prerequisites are inherited from accepted protocol/receipts rather than independently re-audited.
